wire.team_integrations.ask.add_to_channe.note: {channel} is a channel name already prefixed with '#'.

wire.team_integrations.ask.create_hook.q.note: {source} is a monitoring product identifier (datadog, grafana, alertmanager, generic) and stays as is. An automation receives alerts from that product.

wire.team_integrations.ask.details.chann.note: {channels} is a comma-separated list of '#name' channels, or the word for 'none'.

wire.team_integrations.ask.details.crede.note: Same as the token line, for the secret that authenticates a monitoring product's webhook.
No credential is created by this action.
{secret_name} is a secret name identifier (e.g. RADIENT_APP_TOKEN) and stays as is. Reassures that the token is stored locally and not displayed.

wire.team_integrations.ask.details.none.note: Shown in place of an empty channel list.

wire.team_integrations.ask.details.permi.note: {permissions} is a list like 'chat:write (post messages)'; the codes stay English, the parentheses carry the translated scope words.

wire.team_integrations.ask.mint_token.qu.note: Asks whether to create a new bearer credential (app token) for the app. {app_name} app name, {org_name} organization name.

wire.team_integrations.ask.publish.quest.note: {app_name} is the integration app name the user chose; {org_name} is the Radient organization name. Keep the typographic quotes around the app name. Approving makes the app live in the organization's channels.

wire.team_integrations.ask.rotate_token..note: Asks whether to replace an existing app token. {token_id} is an identifier like itk_0123… and stays as is.

wire.team_integrations.option.approve.note: Affirmative option on token, automation and channel asks.

wire.team_integrations.option.approve.de.note: Single use: approving authorizes one change only.

wire.team_integrations.option.approve_pu.note: Affirmative option on the publish ask.
{secret_name} is an identifier and stays as is.

wire.team_integrations.option.cancel.note: Negative option. Choosing it changes nothing.

wire.team_integrations.option.cancel.des.note: Under Cancel on the other asks.

wire.team_integrations.option.cancel_dra.note: Under Cancel on the publish ask: the drafted app stays inactive.

wire.team_integrations.scope.alerts_inge.note: Plain words for the alerts:ingest permission: posting alert cards that may wake automated responders.

wire.team_integrations.scope.chat_write.note: Plain words for the chat:write permission.

wire.team_integrations.scope.chat_write_.note: Plain words for chat:write.thread: replying under messages the app itself posted.
